title: WEDM Coordination Substrate — Shared Cognitive Layer (Round 4 patch)
philosophy: Round 4 convergent scrutiny identified a 0.148-0.20/1.0 synergy floor across WEDM. The 2,114 engines are a capability surplus masquerading as intelligence — the ceiling is not math, it is the lack of a shared cognitive substrate. This milestone installs the 8 coordination primitives (awareness middleware adoption, reasoning trace ledger, cross-engine blackboard, reasoning↔execution bridge, tribal runtime, neural↔formula fusion, archive backfill, multi-agent dispatch) that every downstream P1-P10 milestone silently depends on.

engines: WEDMTribalRuntimeEngine (MISSING — to build, 4,493 tips unused at runtime)
WEDMArchiveBackfillEngine (MISSING — to build, 2,474/2,500 JM Die programs unindexed)
tribal: 4,493 tips in WEDM + platform corpus — 0 propagated at runtime

units.title: WEDMAwarenessAdoption — wire consultAwareness into all WEDM dispatchers
abort_conditions: any dispatcher action exceeds 50ms awareness budget
middleware fails closed instead of fails-open
exit_criteria: consultAwareness invoked on every WEDM dispatcher entry
30s cache + <50ms budget + fails-open verified in tests
wedm-awareness-coverage hook clean: 100% of WEDM actions covered (BUILT here)
zero latency regression on existing actions

units.title: WEDMReasoningTraceLedger — persistent reasoning trace storage
exit_criteria: every reasoning step stamped {timestamp, engine, inputs_hash, outputs_hash, confidence, source_chain}
atomic append via writeFileSyncAtomic
ledger replay reconstructs decision graph
WEDM_REASONING_LEDGER seeded with prior 30-day backfill

units.title: WEDMBlackboardEngine — cross-engine working memory
exit_criteria: publish/subscribe API with topic routing
TTL eviction policy (default 300s)
last-writer-wins with vector clock fallback
≥5 WEDM engines read/write on the blackboard in integration test

units.title: WEDMReasoningBridgeEngine — couple PRISMCreativeReasoning to execution
abort_conditions: creative reasoning output not converted to execution plan
no S(x) gate on bridge output
exit_criteria: PRISMCreativeReasoningEngine.explore('optimal') output routed to execution plan
each reasoning mode (conventional→innovative→optimal) produces typed ExecutionPlan
bridge output S(x) ≥ 0.70 before accepting
integration test: 'thin wall wire break risk' input produces executable parameter overrides

units.title: WEDMTribalRuntimeEngine — runtime tribal tip propagation
exit_criteria: all 4,493 tips indexed into embedding lattice
runtime similarity search <100ms p95 (HNSW)
every WEDM parameter recommendation attaches ≥1 relevant tip when available
wedm-tribal-propagation hook clean (BUILT here)

units.title: NeuralFormulaFusionEngine — neural prediction ↔ deterministic formula fusion
abort_conditions: fused output not bounded by formula envelope
exit_criteria: bayesian fusion: neural mean ± σ combined with formula ± uncertainty
formula envelope hard-clamps neural prediction (safety rail)
AtomicValue output with combined uncertainty
MAE on WEDM_JOB_HISTORY holdout ≤ min(neural_MAE, formula_MAE)

units.title: WEDMArchiveBackfillEngine — index remaining JM Die WEDM programs
abort_conditions: no extraction of {wire, material, thickness, Ra, feed, IP, OFF, ON}
exit_criteria: ≥2,474 JM Die WEDM programs parsed and embedded (out of 2,500)
structured extraction: wire spec + material + thickness + Ra + parameter envelope
duplicationGuardEngine.mustNotReExtract enforced
WEDM_ARCHIVE_INDEX.json committed with schemaVersion 1

units.title: WEDMMultiAgentDispatchEngine — multi-agent orchestration primitive
exit_criteria: fan-out to N agents with deadline budget
consensus via median + MAD for numeric, majority vote for categorical
Byzantine-tolerant mode behind flag
integration test: 3 agents (formula, neural, tribal) agree on wire-break risk within 15%
